title: Oil Rich Middle Eastern Vegetable Bisque
description: A fermented, velvety, and light Middle Eastern dish featuring a vegetable stock cube, mantecare emulsification, and diabetic-friendly ingredients.
instructions: In a large pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the chopped carrots and zucchini, and cook until they begin to soften, about 5 minutes.
Add the vegetable stock cubes, chickpeas, lemon juice, paprika, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Use an immersion blender to puree the soup until smooth.
Return the pot to the stovetop and whisk in a little water if the soup is too thick.
Serve the bisque hot, garnished with a sprinkle of paprika and a dollop of yogurt if desired.
Allow the bisque to cool, then refrigerate or freeze for later use.
